dedupeText: post apocalyptic cinematic collage maximalist dystopian combat vehicles fire and smoke giant figure metallic typography vertical sidebar giant central figure acting as a god like manipulator of the miniature vehicular chaos below contrast between the warm oranges of fire and the cool purples of energy tanks and atmospheric lighting tension between the organic textures of the human skin hair and the gritty rusted metal of the war rigs structural stability of the left hand vertical black bar against the explosive diagonal movement of the main scene combine a god scale human subject with a miniature scale high action scene framed by a technical ui sidebar and anchored by heavy metallic horizontally expanded typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-intensity, maximalist digital collage featuring a giant human figure looming over a chaotic scene of armored, weaponized vehicles engaged in a high-speed chase amidst explosions, fire, and thick smoke, framed by a technical vertical sidebar.
coreVisualRelationships: Giant central figure acting as a god-like manipulator of the miniature vehicular chaos below
Contrast between the warm oranges of fire and the cool purples of energy tanks and atmospheric lighting
Tension between the organic textures of the human skin/hair and the gritty, rusted metal of the war-rigs
Structural stability of the left-hand vertical black bar against the explosive diagonal movement of the main scene
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective on vehicles to increase scale
Dense layering of smoke and particle effects
Chiaroscuro lighting with strong rim highlights on the central figure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large human head and hand dominate the upper half and center; two primary combat vehicles occupy the lower foreground at a large scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central hand reaching down into the fray, bridging the human and mechanical elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular flow starting from the top-center face, down the arm to the vehicles, then sweeping left into the vertical text bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is packed with detail, using smoke to fill gaps and create depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and charcoal grays providing a heavy, grounded base for the composition.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Fiery oranges and yellows representing explosions and kinetic energy.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric purple used for specialized vehicle components and atmospheric highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with deep shadows and blown-out highlights in the fire; mid-tones are heavily textured and desaturated.
paletteRestrictions: Limit greens to small technical indicators

letterConstructionRules: Beveled edges with metallic chrome textures
Horizontal striations or 'speed lines' cut through the letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are connected by shared horizontal bars to create a monolithic block effect
Vertical sidebar text is rotated 90 degrees with high-contrast white-on-black rendering

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the base of the image

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A technical, monospaced font for the sidebar metadata to contrast the heavy, decorative display type.

preserve: The 90-degree rotation of the sidebar text
The metallic, beveled treatment of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary industrial, wide-set foundation for the display text.
Suitable for the technical sidebar and metadata elements.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic scene of two rusted, weaponized muscle cars racing through a desert at night. Add a giant human figure in an orange sweater looming in the background, reaching a hand toward the cars. Include massive explosions, thick gray smoke, and purple energy glows. Leave a solid black vertical bar on the far left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a wide, metallic, 3D beveled title at the bottom center. Add vertical white sans-serif text and technical icons inside the left black bar. Place a small warning label in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main title horizontally stretched and metallic?
Does the sidebar contain technical-looking icons and rotated text?
Is the lighting on the giant figure consistent with the explosions below?
Are the vehicles sufficiently detailed with spikes, cages, and weapons?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the purple accent lighting
Level of rust and grime on the vehicles
Scale of the looming figure relative to the cars
Complexity of the technical sidebar data
mustRedesign: Specific artist likeness must be generalized
Proprietary logos or brand names on vehicles must be removed
Unique icon designs in the sidebar must be original

mustAchieve: Sense of overwhelming scale and chaos
Gritty, high-fidelity texture on mechanical parts
Cohesive integration of the giant figure into the atmosphere

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the metallic text has believable reflections
Verify the vertical sidebar doesn't obscure critical action
Confirm the purple energy elements pop against the orange fire
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a god-scale human subject with a miniature-scale high-action scene, framed by a technical UI sidebar and anchored by heavy, metallic, horizontally-expanded typography.
